summary.text: Tang Qiong is a yellow scaled mermaid, adorable and gentle, whose smile shows dimples. She is an elder in charge of the Merman Imperial Court.

claims.text: In Eastern Sea a Gu Immortal appears outside Dragon Palace. She greets Wu Shuai. She represents a portion of the Merman Imperial Court’s will. She is their representative, has interacted with Wu Shuai deeply, and always keeps a polite attitude, treating him as an actual senior. Wu Shuai brings her into Dragon Palace. She says this is not her first visit and that she is still in awe of Dragon Palace’s grand appearance, with a sincere expression. Wu Shuai addresses her as Fairy Tang Qiong.

She says Qi Sea Ancestor is holding a banquet in Eastern Sea and has invited the entirety of Eastern Sea Gu Immortal world. Her Imperial Court received the invitation, and their grand elder wants to know if Wu Shuai will go with them. She says Qi Sea Ancestor has announced that he will not invite Fang Yuan: this banquet is an Eastern Sea banquet, and Fang Yuan is not an Eastern Sea Gu Immortal. She encourages Wu Shuai that in her tribe’s opinion he and Fang Yuan are not the same entity, that Fang Yuan is a human who is ruthless and hard to read, and that dragonmen need to rely on themselves to become a force of their own. According to her tribe’s deductions, Qi Sea Ancestor is a lone cultivator who likely wants to stay neutral, has made agreements with both Heavenly Court and Fang Yuan, and would welcome Wu Shuai, even though his attitude might not be too enthusiastic nor cold. She leaves Dragon Palace.
She is a yellow scaled mermaid. She is adorable and gentle. She smiles, and dimples are seen on her face.

Mermaid Gu Immortals of the Merman Imperial Court enter Fang Yuan’s sovereign immortal aperture. Twelfth Hair comes to receive them. After a short conversation with him, Yu Zi casts a glance at her. She is a supreme elder of the Merman Imperial Court. She has yellow scales and is gentle and beautiful. Her smile shows dimples that amplify her cuteness. Her status is lower than Yu Zi, Lian Ke Xin, and Xie Ning Si, and she is only below these three. The three give her great authority. She spends her time managing the political affairs and has outstanding interpersonal skills.

After Yu Zi’s approval, she goes up and hands Twelfth Hair a seashell, a rare rank seven refinement path immortal material. She carefully asks Twelfth Hair whether Fairy Miao Yin is the Star Collection City Lord. Before coming, the Merman Imperial Court prepared gifts for Fang Yuan’s well known subordinates like Fairy Miao Yin and Lady White Rabbit, but because of the tense atmosphere earlier, she could not offer the gift.
She quickly expresses gratitude to Twelfth Hair and hands over a gift again.
After the mermaid immortals calm down, she asks what the profound use of this sub-hall is.
